title: Specify and test zero-execution outcomes for registered Vitest verification
outcome: Registered Vitest verification has an explicit behavior for a successful process whose filter executes no tests, supported by behavioral evidence rather than assumed test counts.
acceptance: A behavioral case covers a Vitest filter selecting zero executed tests and records the actual classification/outcome/count evidence.
Any tightened passing-Test policy uses validated runner evidence and applies consistently to direct Node and existing Vitest routes; no summary text or client label substitutes for that evidence.
